## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any check you could not run.
For UI changes, include sanitized before/after screenshots or a short recording.

- [ ] I ran `bun test tests/` and `bun run build` from `cli-node/`.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I updated relevant docs and added regression coverage where behavior changed.
- [ ] This PR contains no credentials, private paths, or real conversation data.
